“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: and he said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
translations.bsb: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one camp, then the other camp can escape.”
translations.kjv: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
translations.asv: and he said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the company which is left shall escape.
